name: super-voice
description: Hear Codex answer what you say to it, with Super Voice on your own machine.

interface.shortDescription: Hear Codex answer what you say to it.
interface.longDescription: When you dictate a prompt with Super Voice, Codex's answer is read aloud. A prompt you type is answered in writing. $read reads a reply aloud again. Super Voice lists each Codex conversation, and says aloud when Codex needs your permission.
